nodes.description: address public owner in Ownable, privileged account enforced by onlyOwner
mapping(address => WithdrawalRecord[]) public withdrawalList holding pending withdrawals
mapping(address => uint256) public lastWithdrawnIndex cursor for withdrawals
TradeRecord[] public tradeRecords append-only trade history
AuctionItem[] public auctionItems list of auctioned lots
Bid[] public bidHistory list of all bids
uint256[] internal crabPartMultiplier = [0,10**9,10**6,10**3,1] gene digit weights
mapping(bytes4 => uint256) internalUintVariable config storage keyed by pre-generated selectors
mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) internal legendaryPartIndex mapping element to legendary set indexes
mapping(bytes4 => uint256) prizePools accumulated pool balances
mapping(address => mapping(bytes4 => uint256)) winners claimable prize amounts
MarketItem[] public marketItems player-to-player sale listings
uint256[] public tradedPrices history used for dynamic crab pricing
bytes4 public currentPrizePool selector for prize pool routing
address public withdrawer address allowed to pull contract ether
mapping(bytes4 => mapping(uint256 => CrabPartData[])) internal crab part stat data
mapping(uint256 => uint256) internal crabSpecialSkins per token skin id
mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => bool))) private stores RBAC table
mapping(uint256 => address) internal tokenOwner ERC721 ownership map
mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) internal operatorApprovals ERC721 operator map
Transmuter.xenograft(uint256,uint256,uint256) external, transplants donor part into recipient, burns cryptant
Transmuter.mutate(uint256,uint256) external, mutates a crab part and updates gene/level/exp/mutationCount
CryptantCrabMarket.purchase(uint256,uint256,address) external payable primary sale entry point
CryptantCrabMarket.buyCrab(uint256) external payable buys an escrowed market listing
CryptantCrabMarket.sellCrab(uint256,uint256) external escrows a crab for sale
CryptantCrabMarket.cancelOnSaleCrab(uint256) external cancels listing and releases escrow
PrizePool.claimPrize(bytes4) external transfers claimable prize to msg.sender
PrizePool.increasePrizePool(bytes4) external payable adds msg.value into a pool
PrizePool.addWinner(address,bytes4,uint256) external whitelisted winner registration
CryptantCrabMarketStore.clearPendingWithdrawal(address) external sums and marks withdrawals
CryptantCrabMarketStore.addWithdrawal(address,uint256,uint256,uint256) external appends withdrawal record
CryptantCrabMarketStore.addBidder(uint256,address,uint256,uint256) external records a bid
CryptantCrabMarketStore.addAuctionItem(uint256,uint256,address,uint256) external creates auction
CryptantCrabMarketStore.addTradeRecord(...) external records a trade
CryptantCrabMarketStore.updateAuctionTime(uint256,uint256,uint256) external mutates auction end time and state
Withdrawable.withdraw(uint256) external onlyWithdrawer sends ether out
CryptantCrabPurchasableLaunch._refundExceededValue(uint256,uint256) internal refunds msg.value surplus
CryptantCrabPurchasableLaunch._createCrab(...) internal mints token and writes gene/level/heart/growth
Transmuter.generateBonusForGene(uint256) external view computes legendary bonuses
Transmuter.isLegendaryPart(uint256,uint256) internal view checks legendary status of a part
LevelCalculator.expRequiredToReachLevel(uint256) internal pure loops to sum exp requirement
Randomable._generateRandom(bytes32) internal view from blockhash(block.number-1)
Randomable._generateRandomNumber(bytes32,uint256) internal view modulo pseudorandom
StoreRBAC.checkRole(uint256,address,uint256) public view require(hasRole(...))
StoreRBAC.adminAddRole(uint256,address,uint256) public onlyAdmin grants role
ERC721BasicToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public canTransfer transfers NFT
ERC721BasicToken.safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256) public calls receiver hook
CryptantCrabNFT.mintToken(address,uint256,uint256) external onlyIfWhitelisted mints crab
CryptantCrabNFT.setPartData(uint256,uint256,uint256[]) external onlyOwner adds part data
CryptantCrabNFT.giftToken(address,address,uint256) external safe transfer wrapper
_addCryptantFragments(address,uint256) internal credits cryptant via SafeMath add
_removeCryptantFragments(address,uint256) internal debits cryptant via SafeMath sub
msg.sender caller controlled address
block.timestamp (now) miner influenceable time value
external call withdrawer.transfer(_amount) after balance check
external call msg.sender.transfer(_exceededValue) refund
external call _referral.transfer(_referralReward) to arbitrary address
external call prizePool.increasePrizePool.value(...)(currentPrizePool)
external call marketItem.seller.transfer(_sellerAmount) paying untrusted seller
external call msg.sender.transfer(_claimableAmount) before zeroing winner entry
arithmetic prizePools[_prizePool] += msg.value unchecked accumulation
arithmetic _withdrawnAmount += _withdrawalRecord.value unchecked accumulation
parameter _amount of Withdrawable.withdraw
parameter _marketId of CryptantCrabMarket.buyCrab
parameter _referral of CryptantCrabMarket.purchase
parameter _crabAmount of CryptantCrabMarket.purchase
parameter _xenograftPart of Transmuter.xenograft
parameter _tokenId of Transmuter.mutate
local _claimableAmount read from winners mapping in claimPrize
local _withdrawnAmount accumulated in clearPendingWithdrawal
local _totalPrice computed in purchase
parameter _recipientTokenId of Transmuter.xenograft

edges.reason: withdraw is guarded by onlyWithdrawer comparing msg.sender to withdrawer
claimPrize transfers ether directly to msg.sender
buyCrab pays out msg.value proceeds and delivers the NFT to msg.sender
purchase mints to and refunds msg.sender with value transfers
purchase uses now to compute LAST_TRANSACTION_PERIOD for pricing
addAuctionItem stores now as auction startTime
addBidder timestamps the bid with now
addWithdrawal records now as the withdrawal time
checkRole validates the role held by msg.sender
onlyAdmin modifier checks msg.sender against RBAC_ROLE_ADMIN
xenograft requires msg.sender to own both recipient and donor tokens
mutate requires msg.sender to own the token
sellCrab requires msg.sender to be the token owner
cancelOnSaleCrab requires msg.sender to be the recorded seller
withdraw performs the external ether transfer to withdrawer
_refundExceededValue transfers surplus ether back to msg.sender
purchase transfers the referral reward to the caller supplied _referral
purchase forwards prize pool cut via external value call
buyCrab pays the seller before finalising the item state
claimPrize transfers before clearing the winner balance
increasePrizePool adds msg.value to the stored pool total
clearPendingWithdrawal sums withdrawal values into _withdrawnAmount
parameter _amount flows into the withdraw transfer
parameter _marketId indexes marketItems in buyCrab
parameter _referral is the payout recipient in purchase
parameter _crabAmount drives the mint loop in purchase
parameter _xenograftPart selects the gene part in xenograft
parameter _tokenId identifies the crab mutated in mutate
parameter _recipientTokenId is written by xenograft storage updates
claimPrize reads _claimableAmount from the winners mapping
clearPendingWithdrawal accumulates _withdrawnAmount over the loop
purchase computes _totalPrice from crab and cryptant unit prices
onlyAdmin modifier invokes checkRole before adminAddRole body executes
safeTransferFrom delegates to transferFrom for the actual move
purchase invokes _refundExceededValue for surplus msg.value
purchase invokes _createCrab for each crab bought
buyCrab calls safeTransferFrom to release the escrowed token
mutate consults isLegendaryPart when rebuilding the gene
mutate requests a pseudorandom legendary bonus via _generateRandomNumber
mutate debits cryptant through _removeCryptantFragments
purchase credits cryptant fragments through _addCryptantFragments
xenograft debits cryptant through _removeCryptantFragments
generateBonusForGene draws bonuses with _generateRandomNumber
the external seller transfer can re-enter buyCrab before state is finalised
the external claim transfer can re-enter claimPrize before the balance is zeroed
the prizePool value call can re-enter purchase
the referral transfer can re-enter purchase
the refund transfer can re-enter _refundExceededValue
the withdrawer transfer can re-enter withdraw
the refund value is sent to msg.sender
the prize amount is sent to msg.sender
the referral reward is sent to the _referral parameter
purchase pushes the traded crab price into tradedPrices
claimPrize reads and zeros the winners mapping entry
increasePrizePool updates the prizePools mapping
clearPendingWithdrawal reads withdrawalList records
clearPendingWithdrawal updates lastWithdrawnIndex
withdraw sends ether to the withdrawer state variable
buyCrab reads and mutates the marketItems listing
sellCrab appends a new listing to marketItems
cancelOnSaleCrab mutates the marketItems state
mutate reads legendaryPartIndex indirectly through isLegendaryPart
addBidder appends to bidHistory
addAuctionItem appends to auctionItems
addTradeRecord appends to tradeRecords
setPartData writes crabPartData entries
mintToken writes crabSpecialSkins when a skin id is given
adminAddRole writes the stores RBAC table
transferFrom rewrites the tokenOwner mapping
xenograft reads config values from internalUintVariable
mutate reads config values from internalUintVariable
purchase reads and writes config values in internalUintVariable
transferFrom consults operatorApprovals via isApprovedOrOwner

normalization_plan.reason: the _amount parameter only exists to size the withdraw ether transfer, so it folds into the withdraw function node
the _marketId parameter is only used to index the marketItems listing inside buyCrab
the _referral parameter is only meaningful as the payout target inside purchase
the _crabAmount parameter drives the mint loop inside purchase and has no standalone meaning
the _xenograftPart parameter only selects the gene slice processed by xenograft
the _tokenId parameter is only an ownership and storage key for mutate
the _recipientTokenId parameter is only a storage key written by xenograft
the _claimableAmount local feeds the external transfer before the winners entry is cleared
the _withdrawnAmount local is a running total owned by clearPendingWithdrawal
the _totalPrice local is computed and consumed entirely within purchase
